war.playerFrontsNote: Owner answer Q-80 (K59): under HISTORICAL a front that a player's realm opens starts the war early, piecemeal; the AI's fronts keep the date. Each front names the realm that opens it (proposed): Lerendor its withdrawal, the West's convener the crossing, the eastern coalition's leader the invasion, Volgan the march and the fall of Mirolon, Zol the rising.

zin_world_no_crown_over_crowns.name: No Crown over Crowns
zin_world_no_crown_over_crowns.desc: The league that crowned this king did not fight for an empire, and the settlement it made binds the crown to that purpose: the realms that bled for Aenor kneel to no one in Parim.

zin_world_lord_of_a_ruined_world.name: Lord of a Ruined World
zin_world_lord_of_a_ruined_world.desc: The grave hosts hold the plains, the client crowns kneel, and the world that remains is ruled by fear and by the dead who will not lie down.

zin_world_the_worshipped_king.name: The Worshipped King
zin_world_the_worshipped_king.desc: The temples are full and the council sits in every court. Here the king is not obeyed so much as adored, and those who doubt him keep their doubts to themselves.

zin_world_outcome_golden_court.name: The Golden Court Endures
zin_world_outcome_golden_court.desc: In this telling of the age the Golden Court outlasted every storm, and Parim still feasts beneath its gilded roofs.

zin_world_outcome_western_crown.name: A Western Crown in Parim
zin_world_outcome_western_crown.desc: In this telling of the age a crown of the West took the oldest city of men and held it, and the western banners still fly over Parim.

zin_world_outcome_strait_master.name: Master of the Strait
zin_world_outcome_strait_master.desc: In this telling of the age no ship passes the Narrow Sea without leave, and the chain across the strait answers to one crown alone.

zin_world_outcome_eastern_king.name: One King in the East
zin_world_outcome_eastern_king.desc: In this telling of the age the caravan roads answer to one crown, and the courts of the East bow to a king of their own choosing.

zin_world.10.title: An Uneasy Season
zin_world.10.desc: In every court of Aoaz the talk has grown careful. Merchants price their cargoes against rumours from the south, envoys linger longer than their errands need, and old treaties are read again by lamplight, as though someone expected to need them.

zin_world.11.title: The Gathering Dark
zin_world.11.desc: No one in Aoaz still calls the peace a peace. Garrisons that slept for a generation are drilling again, the roads carry more soldiers than traders, and in the temples the priests pray for the old safety in words their grandfathers never needed.

zin_world.12.title: The Last Crowns
zin_world.12.desc: The age has come to its edge. Every crown that still stands is arming, and the chroniclers write as though they were recording the last days of an age rather than a season of trouble.

zin_world.20.title: The War of the Last Crowns
zin_world.20.desc: Crowns are arming on every shore of Aoaz. Old grudges have become plans of war and old legends have become banners, and the chroniclers have begun to call the many wars of these years by one name: the War of the Last Crowns.
zin_world.20.descPiecemeal: No single blow began it. One war has followed another across Aoaz until the chroniclers could no longer tell where each began, and now they call them all by one name: the War of the Last Crowns.
zin_world.20.ok: Let every crown look to its walls.
